What works today?+

Local notes, links, images, image text search, media attachments, and voice capture. Edit, organize, back up, and optionally sync an encrypted vault to your private GitHub repo. This is an early build.

Where will my things live?+

Saves currently live in this browser, without encryption or backup. Clearing browser data removes them. Export a readable backup, or connect a private GitHub repo for encrypted sync. Keep your recovery key safe.

And on my phone?+

A responsive web app first, then an installable experience. Native apps and shared inns come later.
